title: Revert Lua pushinteger changes on 4.2
description:
Changing pushnumber to pushinteger doesn't help much on Lua 5.1 and 5.2, which is all the 4.2 branch currently supports, and on 32-bit systems it can lead to incorrect results because of casts.

Lua 5.1 and 5.2 have functions to push unsigned numbers, but there's no guarantee that a Lua function will know a lua_Integer is supposed to be interpreted as unsigned.

Revert this for now; we need to make sure that 32 bit handling correct is correct in the master branch before trying to backport Lua 5.3 and 5.4 support to 4.2.

Related to #19789
